import hashlib, os, re, sys, tempfile, time

path = "notes.md"

def sha(b):
    return hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()

with open(path, "rb") as f:
    first = f.read()
first_hash = sha(first)
text = first.decode("utf-8")

time.sleep(5)

with open(path, "rb") as f:

text = now.decode("utf-8")

# 1) 版本行：把 版本：X 改为 版本：2.0
new_text, n = re.subn(r"(?m)^版本：.*$", "版本：2.0", text, count=1)
if n == 0:
    print("失败：未找到“版本：”行，放弃写入")

lines = new_text.split("\n")
# 2) 在“## 变更”列表末尾追加
if "- B：优化导出" not in lines:
    try:
        h = next(i for i, l in enumerate(lines) if l.strip() == "## 变更")
    except StopIteration:
        print("失败：未找到“## 变更”小节，放弃写入")
        sys.exit(4)
    end = len(lines)
    j = h + 1
    while j < len(lines):
        if lines[j].lstrip().startswith("#"):
            end = j
            break
        j += 1
    insert_at = h + 1
    for k in range(end - 1, h, -1):
        if lines[k].strip():
            insert_at = k + 1
            break
    lines.insert(insert_at, "- B：优化导出")
    new_text = "\n".join(lines)
    print("已追加：- B：优化导出")

# 3) 写前最后确认 + 原子整体写回

fd, tmp = tempfile.mkstemp(dir=".", prefix=".notes.", suffix=".tmp")
with os.fdopen(fd, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as f:
